verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You have ruined me with Your love and I’ll never be the same again
You have ruined me with Your love and I’ll never be the same

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: You love me and I love you, that’s really all that it comes down to

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I try to run, I try to hide
But my heart burns, it burns with Your fire
